entities.name: Hanoi–Đồng Đăng Railway
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: Hanoi–Đồng Đăng railway is a railway line in the country of Vietnam. It is a single-track standard-gauge and metre-gauge (dual-gauge) line connecting the capital Hanoi to Đồng Đăng, on the China-Vietnam border in Lạng Sơn Province. It has a total length of 162 km (101 mi).
